sentences.text:
Author: Rakesh Thapliyal
Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal
Sl. Office Notes,
No. Date reports,
 orders or Court'S Or Judge'S Order

S  proceedings  or directions  and  Registrar's  order with  Signatures  BA2 No. 273 of 2025  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1.
Mr. Rishab Ranghar, learned counsel for the applicant.
Advocate General with Mr. Pratiroop Pandey, learned A.G.A. for the State.

3. This is second bail application moved on behalf of the applicant Sanjay Saklani, S/o J.P. Saklani,
seeking bail in reference to FIR dated 12.09.2024, bearing FIR No. 182 of 2024, registered at P.S.
Prem Nagar, District Dehradun wherein the present applicant along with one Pradeep Juyal have been implicated for the offences punishable under Section 420, 467, 468, 471 read with section 120B IPC.
4.
The first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn on 23.07.2025 with a liberty to file fresh with better particulars.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant, on instructions from the deponent who is the wife of the applicant, submits that the applicant after being released on bail will refund the entire amount of consideration of sale deed along with the interest to the complainant.

Advocate General for the State submits that if the applicant is ready to refund the entire amount to the complainant then in such an eventuality, only for an interim measure, for certain period the interim bail can be granted to the applicant.

7. In view of the statement, as made above, and, particularly, the undertaking as given by the learned counsel for the applicant, the present applicant is granted interim bail only for a period of one month so that after being released on bail he will refund the entire amount towards consideration along with the interest to the complainant.

BA2/273/2025 on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191930324/
1 8.

In view of the above, the present applicant is granted interim bail for a period of one month, to be reckoned from the date of his release, subject to his executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned.

9. It is made clear if the applicant fails to refund the amount within aforesaid period, the interim bail granted will deemed to be cancelled.
10. Put up this matter on 27.11.2025.
11. In the meantime, State may file objection.
